plate.title: B07 · Orthogonal bands and running foliage
plate.description: Narrow horizontal and vertical strips carry separate running stems, with the central crossing left uncluttered. A broad intermediate leaf occupies the larger existing compartment.

constructionNotes: Narrow horizontal and vertical strips carry separate running stems, with the central crossing left uncluttered. A broad intermediate leaf occupies the larger existing compartment. Optional curved display selects only intended flowing paths and retains actual roots, tips and seam landmarks; native execution remains finite chords.
